consent.title: Before you open the calendar
consent.intro: The training calendar collects more than the rest of the site — including data about your body. Before we start, I need your explicit consent.
items: Training plan: title, description, date and the completion tick
Perceived exertion rating RPE (1–10) and your written post-session feedback
Morning weigh-ins with their dates, and the trend calculated from them
Training and weight goals (starting and target weight) set by your coach
Messages in the thread with your coach, plus files: your coach's materials (links, PDFs) and any photos or PDFs you attach in the conversation yourself — those are deleted automatically after a year
consent.coachAccess: Your coach sees all of the above — that is the point of a shared plan. The coach is also shown a signal when weight drops faster than 1% per week. Nobody other than you and your coach has access to this data.
consent.readPolicy: Read the privacy policy (training calendar section)
consent.checkbox: I have read the <1>privacy policy</1> and I consent to the processing of my training data, including weigh-ins and RPE ratings, for the purpose of running my training plan.
consent.withdrawNote: You can withdraw this consent at any time by writing to mateusz.nawratek@outlook.com — I will then delete your training and weight data. Without consent the calendar stays closed; the rest of your account and your bookings work as usual.
